outcome: A person uploads a management-accounts extract, sees it held with its findings, confirms its units and follows the investigation
acceptance_criteria: `/projects/c0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000053/accounts` on the mock (Next 4990, mock 4991) lists the four fixture submissions newest first, with the held one showing both findings with their code, message and "Line 88" and "Line 212" — verify: open the page; `frontend/e2e/accounts-intake.spec.ts` asserts the rows.

The held board shows no row table with "Period is 2026-09, you declared 2026-10" wording and no "File held until corrected" column; a legacy submission with only `findings` strings shows its text — verify: DOM assertion in the e2e spec and a unit test of the findings renderer with `finding_details:[]`.
Submitting the form with a blank control total sends `control_total: null`, never `"0"`, and the page shows "Not given" for it — verify: unit test on the body builder and a captured mock request.

A submit sends `case_revision` from the latest intake read and one `idempotency_key`; a network failure then Retry reuses the same key, and a new submit makes a new one — verify: unit test with a mocked client.

409 on submit shows the changed-while-working message, re-reads the list and keeps the typed values; 422 shows the field message beside `period` — verify: mock cases `...0054` and `...0055`, e2e spec.
A 403 `csrf_failed` does not show no-access; it refreshes the session and says to press again; a 401 shows the signed-out state — verify: unit tests as F-85 criteria 7 and 8.

A submission with `can_confirm_units: true` shows the unit group with no unit preselected; Confirm stays disabled until unit, note and evidence are set, and sends `{action:'confirm_units', case_revision, unit, evidence_id, note}` with `unit` one of `major_currency|thousands_currency|millions_currency` — verify: unit test and e2e on the captured request.
After a unit confirmation the successor is shown and the first submission reads "Replaced by a newer submission" and is read only — verify: e2e on the mock.

A submission with `source_id` and no `work_id` offers "Start management accounts"; pressing it sends `POST /work` with `line:'finance-accounts/v1'`, `intake:{source_id, adjustment_ids:[]}`, a `reference` and one `idempotency_key`, then links to the work page — verify: captured request in e2e.

`/work/5301` shows "Chidi is investigating the accounts." text from `finding`, the "Not posted to the ledger" line and no review, delivery or publish control — verify: open the page; e2e asserts those controls are absent.
`/work/5302` shows the `finding`, `next_action` and a link to `/setup/delegation`, and no reviewer names or reason text beyond what `finding` carries — verify: open the page; DOM assertion.

`/work/5303` lists "Statement contract" and "BU metrics for allocation" each marked "Not set", with the link "Open Finance rules" to `/setup/rules/finance`; when `setup_missing` is empty no rows are invented — verify: open the page and a unit test with an empty list.

`/work/5304` shows `status_reason` in quotes with no reviewer name or date, the declared scope read only, and an upload form; the upload sends multipart with `head_id` 77, `decision_id` 88, `idempotency_key` and the file, and no `Content-Type` header set by hand — verify: captured request in e2e and a unit test of the form-data builder.

"Recheck reviewers" appears only when `can_recheck_reviewers` is true and "Reassess" only when `can_reassess` is true and `source_id` is not null; reassess needs a reason; neither button appears on `/work/5301` — verify: e2e on `5305` against `5301`.

Mapping `61` renders three rows with the null amount as "Not recorded", "Show more rows" requests `after_row` only when the last row has a numeric `source_line`, and `ledger_posted:false` shows "Not posted to the ledger" — verify: unit test and open the page.
`/work/5399` and a live work id the account cannot see both show exactly "This record is unavailable." — verify: open both and compare.

Unknown values: an unrecognised `state` or finding code shows its raw text and nothing is dropped; a null `calculated_at`, `unit` or amount is never drawn as 0 or as a date — verify: unit tests on the adapter.

Against live Django (8030) with an account that may use Finance, a held-file upload, units confirmation and `GET /work/{id}/accounting` match what the page shows — verify: compare with `python3 delivery/connect/oa.py live GET /api/v1/work/{work_id}/accounting 3` and the JSON from `curl` with the session.
No write is sent by `accountingAdapter.commands()`; descriptors carry `case_revision` and `expected_revision` with nulls kept null — verify: adapter unit test.
The phone boards (width 390) show the same content in one column with no horizontal scroll for the findings, the unit group and the forms — verify: Playwright at 390 px on each state.

risk.rationale: Medium. It adds an evidence upload and a units confirmation that changes how a finance extract is read, across several states and a cross-layer contract (`frontend/` against the contract in `contracts/psl-factory.openapi.json`). It posts nothing, moves no money, and shows no restricted payroll data or external messages. Writes carry `case_revision` and an idempotency key. Merge route: the F-105 PR can merge under D-180/D-184 once its reviews pass. F-106 carries the publish risk.

completion.reason: Project, readiness, implementation and review evidence has not been supplied.
